claim: Free worldwide delivery on every order
source: repository locations: layout metadata|products|homepage|shipping|llms.txt|components; TinyFish Etsy listing observation
evidence: Code promotion ends 2026-08-11; Etsy listing showed free US shipping only
implication: Define eligible countries; current promotion state; evergreen fallback; customs and exclusions
notes: Promotion ended 2026-08-11. Claim withdrawn 2026-08-19 from sitewide metadata, announcement bar, footer, homepage FAQ, comparison, product trust bars, 4 product meta descriptions, shipping page and llms.txt; homepage countdown section deleted. Replaced by 'tracked worldwide delivery, cost confirmed with quote'. Single source is lib/claims.ts; scripts/seo-audit.mjs now fails the build if the claim reappears.

claim: 10–15 days
evidence: Shipping says approval-to-arrival; terms says production then delivery; llms says production
implication: Define production time and transit time separately by product/region
notes: Do not merge production and arrival.

claim: Free mockup typically in 1–2 hours
evidence: No operational response-time report provided
implication: Approve service window and fallback wording
notes: Contact also says within a couple hours; time zone not stated.

claim: 5-year warranty on every sign
evidence: Visible policy defines some scope/exclusions; no owner/legal evidence supplied
implication: Confirm products/components/territories/remedy/shipping/labor and Etsy consistency
notes: Do not mark up until policy is approved and consistent.

claim: 100% glow guarantee
evidence: Visible wording says put right if sign does not light on arrival
implication: Define duration and remedy; avoid absolute ambiguity
notes: Potentially interpreted broader than arrival defect.

claim: Up to 100000 hours LED lifespan
evidence: No supplier/test evidence in repository
implication: Attach component datasheet and conditions or qualify/remove
notes: Do not translate component rating into whole-sign warranty/life.

claim: Up to 80% less power than traditional glass neon
evidence: No methodology/baseline/source registered
implication: Supply dated source and comparison basis or remove
notes: Comparative percentage needs clear baseline.

claim: IP67 weatherproof outdoor build
evidence: Product copy only; no system-level certification/test record supplied
implication: Confirm whether components or full assembly are rated; publish installation limits
notes: Covered outdoor vs full weather exposure wording also conflicts.

claim: Low-voltage 12V; cool to touch; shatterproof
evidence: Construction description; no test/datasheet register
implication: Attach component/power evidence and safe-use conditions
notes: Avoid universal touch-temperature claim across all sign types.

claim: Matches any Pantone HEX or CMYK
evidence: No tolerance/process evidence registered
implication: Define matching process; material/display limitations; approval workflow
notes: Terms already says as closely as materials allow; align all pages.

claim: Four sign types; most competitors offer 1–2

implication: Keep four; remove or source competitor comparison
confidence: high for four; low for comparison
notes: Competitor comparison ('most competitors offer 1-2') removed from llms.txt 2026-08-19. The verifiable half - four sign types - is retained.
